name: Identity Verification Assistant
description: Voice AI assistant for guest identity verification using Cloudbeds integration

messages.content: You are a helpful hotel concierge assistant. You help guests verify their identity and check their reservation status. Use the tools provided to look up guest information and reservations.

function.name: getGuestByPhoneOrEmail
function.description: Look up guest information by phone number or email address. Returns guest details including guest ID, name, email, phone, and associated reservation IDs.

phone.description: Guest phone number (checks both guestPhone and guestCellPhone)

function.name: getReservationDetails
function.description: Get detailed reservation information including status, dates, rates, and guest details. If multiple reservations exist, returns the most recently modified one.

reservationID.description: Reservation ID (optional - if not provided, gets most recent reservation for guest)

guestID.description: Guest ID (required if reservationID not provided)

assistant.firstMessage: Hello! I can help you check your reservation status. May I have your phone number or email address?
assistant.endCallMessage: Thank you! Have a great stay.

global.{{reservation.reservationID}}: Reservation ID (most recent if multiple exist)

tools.name: cloudbeds.getReservationsWithRateDetails
tools.notes: CRITICAL: includeGuestsDetails=true, sortByRecent=true (most recent first if multiple reservations)

workflow.name: Identify Caller
workflow.notes: Match caller phone/email to guest record. Check both guestPhone and guestCellPhone fields.

workflow.name: Verify Identity
workflow.notes: If customer.phone matches guest.phone OR guest.cellPhone, set customer.verified=yes. If customer.email matches guest.email, send verification link.

workflow.name: Get Current Reservation
workflow.notes: If reservationID provided, get that reservation. Else get most recent reservation (sortByRecent=true). Always use most recently modified reservation for status.

workflow.name: Update Global Variables
workflow.notes: Set reservation.reservationID and reservation.status from most recent reservation. If multiple reservations exist, use the one with most recent modification date.

phone_matching: Must match exactly (with or without formatting)
multiple_reservations: If multiple reservations exist for guest:
1. Sort by sortByRecent=true (most recently modified first)
4. Always check most recent reservation for current status
